name: Astronauts and Asteroids
author: GeorgeLikesLego
description:
This simple parkour mini-game is my third LEGO Microgame, where you have to make your way across the hectic asteroid field and reach the third blue checkpoint (with the retro LEGO Space logo on) before your oxygen runs out. I had a blast making this game, and I hope you enjoy playing it!

Also, my LEGO Ideas username is G789789789, so please check my other projects out! Thank you!
